outcome_taxonomy.admitted: all writer-side ordered predicates passed; this is not restart adoption or H4 entry
outcome_taxonomy.rejectedBeforePublication: staging creation was not entered and empty namespace is re-proven
outcome_taxonomy.transactionOutcomeUnknown: COMMIT was entered without an exact successful return
outcome_taxonomy.prepublicationStateUnknown: no rename was entered, but exact inspection cannot prove both that staging creation was never entered and that the final leaf is absent
outcome_taxonomy.stagingRetained: before rename, the created named staging leaf remains joined to the held regular effective-uid-owned nlink-1 vnode; its currently observed mode, size and bytes are retained and are not necessarily sealed or image-exact
outcome_taxonomy.publicationOutcomeUnknown: rename was entered without an exact successful return, or the post-entry namespace cannot be classified exactly
outcome_taxonomy.publishedUnverified: rename succeeded but a later durability, identity, reconstruction, close, lifetime or completion predicate failed
outcome_taxonomy.unavailable: one-shot owner or store claim failed after coordinator construction and before mutation

hard_stops: Do not migrate, rewrite, rename, clean, repair, delete or adopt any D2b/v2 namespace.
Do not derive canonical JSON from CBOR or canonical CBOR from JSON.
Do not let a caller supply paths, bytes, SQL, schema, flags, clocks, owners, roles or faults in production.
Do not let D2b and D3 both consume one copied owner-bound projection.
Do not call writer-side admitted a restart adoption, H4 entry, candidate evaluation or authority transition.
Do not add graph, Merkle, crash-cut, constrained-I/O, process, VM, network, UI, distribution or Gate-E work to this allowlist.
residuals: The named-staging snapshot-to-rename interval cannot atomically instruct Darwin to rename one exact held inode; descriptor, inventory and post-rename joins detect but do not prevent every same-uid substitution.
Advisory flock does not exclude same-euid, root or Full-Disk-Access mutation.
fsync and F_FULLFSYNC are returned Darwin durability requests, not mathematical proof against every device, firmware, filesystem or power-loss failure.
Filesystem, SQLite and transition-lock calls have no independent constrained-I/O deadline.
Same-process writer reconstruction is not fresh-process restart evidence.
nonclaims: D3 proves only the frozen local fixture publication mechanics on its exact implementation and test objects.
SQLite is a checked non-authoritative container; JSON, CBOR and scalar agreement creates no truth or authority.
No authenticity, anti-replay, rollback resistance, historical owner recovery, H4 entry, Gate-E movement, candidate result or scientific conclusion is claimed.
No successor stage or authority-bearing launch is authorized by this freeze.
